units: <cite ref="Mishnah Bava Batra 3:6">B. Bath. III, 6</cite> <he>ח׳ המצרית וכ׳</he> the Egyptian window (a very small aperture in the wall) gives no privilege (v. <cite ref="H00556"><he>חֲזָקָה</he></cite>), i.e. the neighbor may build against it, contrad. to <he>הצורית</he> a Tyrian window.
<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 31:12">Gen. R. s. 31</cite>, expl. <he>צהר</he> (<cite ref="Genesis 6:16">Gen. VI, 16</cite>); a. v. fr.—Pl. <he>חַלּוֹנוֹת</he>.

<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Rosh Hashanah 2:2:4">Y. R. Hash. II, 58ᵃ</cite>; <cite ref="Shemot Rabbah 15:22">Ex. R. s. 15</cite> <he>שס״ה ח׳ וכ׳</he> 365 apertures did the Lord create in the sky; a. fr.
